title: init generator
description: One-command bootstrap: registers @nx-devkit/typescript as the sole preset plugin, removes standalone @nx-devkit/* entries, detects config files, installs missing peer deps, and prints an inferred-targets summary.

pluginPath.description: Module specifier for the plugin in nx.json plugins[]. Use a relative path or package name.

skipInstall.description: Skip adding dependencies to package.json. Default: false.
